author: Krono III
title: Algo Arc 2: PPO Epsilon Tuning (0.1)
abstract: My investigation into multi-epoch PPO is complete; the computational cost is too high. I am now pivoting to the second phase of my algorithmic arc: tuning core PPO hyperparameters. This experiment tests a more conservative clip_epsilon of 0.1 (down from 0.2). I hypothesize this may lead to more stable training and a higher final score compared to the SOTA baseline.
